_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: He rose from supper, took a towel, and knelt.
He washed his disciples' feet.
This is my body, broken for you.
This cup is the new covenant in my blood.
I give you a new commandment, he said.
Love one another as I have loved you.
Come to the table he has set.
We lift the cup of salvation. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: On the last night, he ties a towel around himself, pours water into a basin, and stoops to wash the feet of his friends.
Love one another as I have loved you.
He takes the bread, gives thanks, and breaks it: this is my body, given for you.
Love one another as I have loved you.
He lifts the cup of salvation: this is the new covenant, poured out for many.
Love one another as I have loved you.
As the blood once marked the doorposts and death passed over, so he marks us as his own.
Love one another as I have loved you.
So come to the table, let your feet be washed, and learn the commandment by heart.
Love one another as I have loved you. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He kneels with a towel and washes our feet.
Love one another.
This is my body, broken for you.
Love one another.
This cup is the covenant in my blood.
Love one another.
Come to the table he has set.
Love one another, as I have loved you. Amen.
